description: This file is a Service Worker script that handles installation, activation, and fetch events in a web application environment.

methods.name: install event listener
methods.description: Handles the Service Worker installation event, triggering skipWaiting to activate the new Service Worker immediately.

methods.name: activate event listener
methods.description: Handles the activation event, claiming control of clients immediately after activation.

methods.name: fetch event listener
methods.description: Intercepts fetch requests and logs the requested URL; it's essential for the specific issue this script addresses.
